item.title: 1965 Rambler Ambassador 990 Convertible 327
item.description: This 1965 Rambler Ambassador 990 convertible is finished in gold over a black vinyl interior, and the car is powered by a 327ci V8 paired with a three-speed automatic transmission. Details include a power-operated black convertible top, aftermarket headlights, power steering, and power brakes in addition to a Holley four-barrel carburetor, a dual exhaust system, front bucket seats, a center console, and a push-button AM radio. item.title: 1967 Morris Minor 6cwt Pickup at No Reserve
item.description: This 1967 Morris Minor is a left-hand-drive 6cwt pickup that was delivered new to the United States and is said to have belonged to the president of a Morris Minor club when it was featured on BaT in March 2015. The seller purchased the truck on BaT in January 2017. Powered by a 1,098cc inline-four linked to a four-speed manual transmission, the vehicle is finished in Almond Green over brown vinyl. item.title: 22k-Mile 2018 Audi TT RS
item.description: This 2018 Audi TT RS is one of 725 produced for its model year in the US market, of which 90 were finished in Glacier White Metallic over a black and Crescendo Red interior. The car was acquired in 2020 by the seller, after which it was modified in the style of the German-market TT RS "40 years of quattro" edition. item.title: 1957 Austin-Healey 100-6 BN4 Roadster
item.description: This 1957 Austin-Healey 100-6 BN4 roadster was built on March 19, 1957 and sold new through Sheward Motor Company of Pittsburg, Kansas. The car remained with its original owner for 53 years, received a Bloomington Gold ZZenith certificate of preservation in 2011, and was previously listed on BaT in March 2020. item.title: 34k-Mile 2007 Porsche 911 Turbo Coupe 6-Speed
item.description: This 2007 Porsche 911 Turbo coupe is finished in Atlas Gray Metallic over Stone Gray leather and powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.6L flat-six that drives all four wheels via a six-speed manual transaxle. Equipment includes the Sport Chrono Package, a power sunroof, bi-xenon headlights, 19" Turbo wheels, power-adjustable front seats, automatic climate control, cruise control, a Bose sound system, and PCM with navigation. item.description: This 2005 Cadillac XLR is powered by a 4.6-liter Northstar V8 paired with a five-speed automatic transmission, and it has 82k miles. item.description: This 2004 Bentley Continental GT is finished in Cypress over Saddle leather and has 58k miles following history in Michigan since new. item.title: 2006 Ferrari F430 Challenge Race Car
item.description: This 2006 Ferrari F430 Challenge race car was acquired by the current owner from Ferrari Westlake of Thousand Oaks, California, in 2020 and used as a track car over their ensuing six years with the car. Finished in white with an FF Corse front bumper cover and carbon-fiber rear wing, the car is powered by a 4.3-liter DOHC V8 mated to a six-speed F1 sequential transaxle with mechanical limited-slip differential. item.title: 18k-Mile 2012 Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG
item.description: This 2012 Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG has 18k miles, and it has been registered in California, Nevada, and Arkansas from new.
